CustomField.description:
Created as part of the Auto Lead Assignment project at request of Alex R.
The formula first checks the old Region picklist field for a value, if it finds one then it returns that value. This is in place to ensure that the transition from the old Region (picklist) field to the new Region (Formula) field is smooth.
If it doesn’t find a value, it uses the Country (Lookup) field’s “Region” field and returns it.
If no Country (Lookup) field is found, it returns “Unknown”
CustomField.formula: IF ( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Region__c))), /* If old Region picklist field contains a value... */ TEXT(Region__c), /* Then, use that value... */ IF ( NOT(ISBLANK(Country_Lookup__c)), /* Otherwise, if the new Country lookup field is populated... */ Country_Lookup__r.Region__c , /* Then, use the "Region" field value on the Country record */ "Unknown" /* Otherwise, return "Unknown" */ ) )
CustomField.label: Region
